_comment: Registry seed. Every entry must be a REAL Nimiq receiving address belonging to a REAL Mini App.
Collect these from other builders — that is the distribution mechanic (PRD F5).
Do not invent addresses: the product's whole claim is that its data is real (ADR-8).
Entries here are inserted as APPROVED, which skips moderation. Only seed apps you trust.
Seeded only with `npm run seed -- --demo`. These are real, high-activity mainnet
addresses used to prove the indexing pipeline end to end. They are NOT Mini Apps.
Never leave these in a registry shown to judges or users.
